messages:
tess: Heads-up: Marcos (BR) reported his Mar 31 net was much lower. Looks like both Payline and LocalPay ran contributions on the conversion month. Pay IDs: `PL-2026-03-31-09` and `LP-2026-03-31-77`. Screenshot attached. Can payroll confirm?

lea (People Ops): Thanks Tess. Marcos converted from contractor -> employee effective 2026-03-16. HR record shows country BR for whole month. No SSNs in thread.

marcos (Employee): Hi team  my net was R$6,740 but expected ~R$8,000. Rent due Apr 4 so would appreciate quick fix.

andre (Payroll BR): Pulling runs now. Confirmed both processors applied INSS (employee share) and FGTS employer deposit lines. Snapshot: Gross R$12,000; INSS employee R$1,320; FGTS employer R$960; total deductions shown R$5,280; net paid R$6,740. Expected net if single provider: ~R$8,000.

andre (Payroll BR): Root cause: contractor profile on LocalPay remained active for the month and did contractor->employee mapping which triggered LocalPay to calculate and withhold social contributions in addition to Payline employee run. We'll need to reverse the duplicate LocalPay withholdings and reissue corrected net from canonical provider.

lea (People Ops): Approved to proceed with off-cycle reversal and reissue corrected payment. If the reversal takes >48h, approve a bridging advance up to R$1,500?

andre (Payroll BR): Approved by me to request advance. I'll start reversal now: REV-LP-178999-01. LocalPay reversal ETA 24-48h settlement. Can issue manual advance ADV-178999-01 for R$1,500 today; mark as recoverable on next payroll.

finance-bot: Manual advance queued: ADV-178999-01 R$1,500 to employee MAR-412.

localpay-bot: Off-cycle reversal created: REV-LP-178999-01 for payrun LP-2026-03-31-77.

andre (Payroll BR): After reversal posts, we'll run corrected net via Payline and then issue journal to accounting to reclaim duplicate employer FGTS deposit if paid. I'll open reclaim ticket and attach bank reconciliation.

lea (People Ops): Two action items: 1) disable LocalPay contractor profile for Marcos and set Payline as canonical; 2) add a note to the contractor->employee migration checklist to verify deactivation of legacy payroll profiles.

tess: I'll update the HR migration checklist and confirm the profile disabled.

marcos (Employee): Thanks all. Please DM when advance posts and when corrected pay is issued.

lea (People Ops): Summary: REV-LP-178999-01 started; ADV-178999-01 issued R$1,500; corrected Payline run to follow; accounting reclaim ticket pending. Will update thread as things post. :white_check_mark:
